name: Series
description: Represents a series in a chart.
remarks: The Series object is a member of the SeriesCollection collection.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)
 If .HasChart Then
 .Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
 End If
End With

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: AxisGroup
properties.description: Returns the type of axis group. Read/write XlAxisGroup.

properties.name: Border
properties.description: Returns the border of the object. Read-only ChartBorder.

properties.name: ErrorBars
properties.description: Returns the error bars for the series. Read-only ErrorBars.

properties.name: Explosion
properties.description: Returns or sets the explosion value for a pie-chart or doughnut-chart slice. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: Returns or sets the object's formula in A1-style notation and in the language of the macro. Read/write String.

properties.name: FormulaLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using A1-style references in the language of the user. Read/write String.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the macro. Read/write String.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1Local
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the user. Read/write String.

properties.name: HasDataLabels
properties.description: True if the series has data labels. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasErrorBars
properties.description: True if the series has error bars. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InvertIfNegative
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word inverts the pattern in the object when it corresponds to a negative number. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: MarkerBackgroundColor
properties.description: Sets the marker background color as an RGB value or returns the corresponding color index value. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerBackgroundColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker background color as an index into the current color palette, or as one of the following XlColorIndex constants: xlColorIndexAutomatic or xlColorIndexNone. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerForegroundColor
properties.description: Sets the marker foreground color as an RGB value or returns the corresponding color index value. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerForegroundColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker foreground color as an index into the current color palette, or as one of the following XlColorIndex constants: xlColorIndexAutomatic or xlColorIndexNone. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the data-marker size, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker style for a point or series in a line chart, scatter chart, or radar chart. Read/write XlMarkerStyle.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the object. Read/write String.

properties.name: PictureType
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that specifies how pictures are displayed on a column or bar picture chart. Read/write XlChartPictureType.

properties.name: PlotOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the plot order for the selected series within the chart group. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Smooth
properties.description: True if curve smoothing is enabled for the line chart or scatter chart. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets the series type. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ChartType
properties.description: Returns or sets the chart type. Read/write XlChartType.

properties.name: Values
properties.description: Returns or sets a collection of all the values in the series. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: XValues
properties.description: Returns or sets an array of x values for a chart series. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: BubbleSizes
properties.description: Returns or sets a string that refers to the worksheet cells that contain the x-value, y-value, and size data for the bubble chart. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: BarShape
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape used for a single series in a 3D bar or column chart. Read/write XlBarShape.

properties.name: ApplyPictToSides
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the sides of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyPictToFront
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the front of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyPictToEnd
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the end of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Has3DEffect
properties.description: True if the series has a three-dimensional appearance. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the object has a shadow. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasLeaderLines
properties.description: True if the series has leader lines. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LeaderLines
properties.description: Returns the leader lines for the series. Read-only LeaderLines.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: PictureUnit2
properties.description: Returns or sets the unit for each picture on the chart if the PictureType property is set to xlStackScale; otherwise, this property is ignored. Read/write Double.

properties.name: PlotColorIndex
properties.description: Returns an index value that is used internally to associate series formatting with chart elements. Read-only.

properties.name: InvertColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the fill color for negative data points in a series. Read/write.

properties.name: InvertColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the fill color for negative data points in a series. Read/write.

properties.name: IsFiltered
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that determines whether the specified chart series is filtered out from the chart. Read/write.

properties.name: ParentDataLabelOption
properties.description: Specifies the parent data label option (banner, overlapping, or none) for the specified series within the chart group. Read/write XLParentDataLabelOptions.

properties.name: QuartileCalculationInclusiveMedian
properties.description: True if the series uses an inclusive median quartile calculation method. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: If the series has a picture fill, copies the picture to the Clipboard.

methods.name: DataLabels
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single data label (a DataLabel object) or a collection of all the data labels for the series (a DataLabels collection).

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The number of the data label.

methods.name: ErrorBar
methods.signature: ErrorBar(Direction As XlErrorBarDirection, Include As XlErrorBarInclude, Type As XlErrorBarType, [Amount As Variant], [MinusValues As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Applies error bars to the series.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the error bar direction.

parameters.name: Include
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the error bar parts to include.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the error bar type.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: The error amount. Used for only the positive error amount when Type is xlErrorBarTypeCustom.

parameters.name: MinusValues
parameters.description: The negative error amount when Type is xlErrorBarTypeCustom.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Pastes a picture from the Clipboard as the marker on the selected series.

methods.name: Points
methods.description: Returns a collection of all the points in the series.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or number of the point.

methods.name: Trendlines
methods.description: Returns a collection of all the trendlines for the series.

methods.name: ApplyDataLabels
methods.signature: ApplyDataLabels([Type As XlDataLabelsType], [LegendKey As Variant], [AutoText As Variant], [HasLeaderLines As Variant], [ShowSeriesName As Variant], [ShowCategoryName As Variant], [ShowValue As Variant], [ShowPercentage As Variant], [ShowBubbleSize As Variant], [Separator As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Applies data labels to a series.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of data label to apply.

parameters.name: LegendKey
parameters.description: True to show the legend key next to the point. The default is False.

parameters.name: AutoText
parameters.description: True if the object automatically generates appropriate text based on content.

parameters.name: HasLeaderLines
parameters.description: For the Chart and Series objects, True if the series has leader lines.

parameters.name: ShowSeriesName
parameters.description: True to enable the series name for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowCategoryName
parameters.description: True to enable the category name for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowValue
parameters.description: True to enable the value for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowPercentage
parameters.description: True to enable the percentage for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowBubbleSize
parameters.description: True to enable the bubble size for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The separator for the data label.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)
